title: VirSME Ecosystem | Current Modules and Future Roadmap
description: See the established VirSME foundation today and the evidence-led roadmap toward a broader 20+ application ecosystem.
hero: A proven foundation today. A broader business operating ecosystem over time.
intro: VirSME clearly separates what is established today from what is planned for the future.

items: VirSME Core as the shared operating foundation
VirSME AI as the centralized intelligence and execution layer

blocks.text: The named roadmap areas currently include Finance, Spend, Insights, Marketing, Service, Strategy, Commerce, Supply, Assets, IT, Legal, Govern, Field, Quality and Make. The wider 20+ application vision remains evidence-led and may evolve with customer demand.
Planned as a complete accounting and financial management environment, not merely a workflow connector.
A planned professional ecosystem where businesses can find external experts and provide controlled access to relevant parts of VirSME.
A localisation layer intended to adapt the same platform to country-specific rules, terminology and operating requirements.
Configurations and templates intended to adapt the same platform to different operating models and industries.
VirSME will not build modules simply to increase the module count. Expansion should follow real customer need and preserve one coherent operating foundation.
